right: working or studying very late at night
explanation: <Burn the midnight oil> significa trabajar hasta muy tarde en la noche.

left: the ball is in your court
right: it's your turn to make a decision or take action
explanation: <The ball is in your court> significa que ahora te toca actuar a ti.

left: kill two birds with one stone
right: achieve two things with a single action
explanation: <Kill two birds with one stone> significa lograr dos objetivos al mismo tiempo.

right: not making a decision between two options
explanation: <Sit on the fence> significa estar indeciso o mantenerse neutral.

right: become nervous and afraid to do something planned
explanation: <Get cold feet> significa perder la confianza justo antes de hacer algo.

right: be too late to take advantage of an opportunity
explanation: <Miss the boat> significa perder una oportunidad.

right: something bad that turns out to have a good result
explanation: <A blessing in disguise> significa una desgracia que termina llevando a algo bueno.

right: avoid talking about the main topic directly
explanation: <Beat around the bush> significa evitar ir directo al punto.

right: make a bad situation even worse
explanation: <Add insult to injury> significa empeorar una situación que ya era mala.

right: do something in the cheapest or easiest way
explanation: <Cut corners> significa ahorrar tiempo o dinero haciendo las cosas con menos cuidado.

right: make more effort than is expected
explanation: <Go the extra mile> significa hacer más de lo que se requiere.

right: agree with someone completely
explanation: <See eye to eye> significa tener la misma opinión que alguien.

left: hit the nail on the head
right: describe exactly what is causing a problem
explanation: <Hit the nail on the head> significa acertar exactamente sobre algo.

right: avoid interfering with a situation that could cause trouble
explanation: <Let sleeping dogs lie> significa dejar un problema en paz para no empeorarlo.

left: bite off more than you can chew
right: take on a task that is too big for you
explanation: <Bite off more than you can chew> significa intentar hacer demasiado.

right: cost too much money
explanation: <Break the bank> significa que algo es muy caro.

right: joke with someone or tease them
explanation: <Pull someone's leg> significa bromear con alguien de forma juguetona.

right: without being noticed or attracting attention
explanation: <Under the radar> significa pasar desapercibido.

right: a small visible part of a much larger problem
explanation: <The tip of the iceberg> significa que solo se ve una pequeña parte de un problema mayor.

right: give up or admit defeat
explanation: <Throw in the towel> significa dejar de intentarlo y aceptar el fracaso.
